canonical_project: Microsoft/G42 Olkaria geothermal data centre campus (East Africa Azure cloud region)
owner: G42 with Microsoft and Kenyan partners (KenGen/EcoCloud)
notes: Microsoft/G42 announced (2024-05-22) a $1B digital ecosystem initiative including a geothermal-powered Olkaria data-centre campus for a new East Africa Azure cloud region (initial ~100MW, G42/EcoCloud collaboration with potential expansion to 1GW). 2026 reporting: project stalled/paused over national grid capacity and payment guarantees (Reuters 2026-05-10, DCD), with the Olkaria site reported largely empty (July 2026). Azure region list does not yet include Kenya. Status planned/uncertain - announcement grade A, current status B/C.
